meta.name: jupyter-lab-rocm-half-gpu
meta.description: Jupyter Lab with PyTorch on ROCm / half an AMD GPU, pool amd; PyTorch is capped to the share (oif)

spec.args: -c "echo GPU share: $OIF_GPU_MEMORY_FRACTION of the AMD GPU at $OIF_GPU_PCI; python3 -m pip install --quiet --break-system-packages jupyterlab==${JUPYTERLAB_VERSION} && exec python3 -m jupyterlab --ip=0.0.0.0 --port=8888 --no-browser --allow-root --ServerApp.token='' --ServerApp.allow_remote_access=true"
